scope: Single retrospective diagnostic on publicly mirrored historical SPY option bid/ask, not an N9-S benchmark or prospective N10 validation.

source.license: MIT claimed by repository, original option provenance not independently authenticated
source.quality: Public preservation mirror: not exchange-direct NBBO; quotes EOD snapshots, not guaranteed executable.

policy: Signal at D EOD using SPY D-3 vs D. Select same-day contract from D quote: DTE 7..35, abs(delta) nearest 0.08 in [0.01,0.30], bid>=0.01 ask<=0.45 and spread<=0.20, volume>=1, OI>=50, bid/ask size>=1. Pre-committed one-contract IOC ceiling min(0.45, D ask*1.20+0.03). Order attempt D+1 at EOD observed ask, fill only if ask+0.01<=ceiling; risk max loss <=0.25% initial/ongoing continuous equity. Exit D+2 at EOD observed bid minus slippage; if missing/invalid exit bid book zero recovery (adverse accounting), never omit an executed trade. No overlapping positions. Max 72h from fill to exit. Do not use D+1/D+2 to choose D signal or strike; use next day only for fill rule. Skip dates lacking planned D+2 trading session or 72h eligibility. Always one lot, fully funded.
reference: CASH with exact same $1/day fixed charge; no option variable fees.
metrics: n attempts, fills, rejection and missing receipts
falsifiers: invalid source quote used as execution
unreported data gap or invalid state
decision: descriptive retrospective market-data diagnostic only; no N10 promotion, no return prediction or calibrated options beta.
